svg.title: VisionX System Architecture
svg.desc: Revised supplied architecture preserving four subsystem columns, original icon geometry, palette and separate power strip. Camera and VL53L0X feed Pi Zero 2 W; Pi hotspot connects the Java/XML Android app; connection verification precedes camera/distance reception. Camera stream feeds current YOLOv8s detection, TTS and headphones. Independent implemented offline VXN-RAMNet research core feeds an in-progress Android integration and target route-output policy. IMU-to-Pi acquisition and turn/backtracking fusion are planned. Power remains a conceptual target; no current battery or electrical wiring is asserted.

g.text: INTEGRATION / TEST • YOLOv8s now, VXN port next
PROPOSED / NEXT STAGE • IMU + route guidance
Current test and offline core are separate
Temporary detector; not the navigation core
Live route inference + conversion parity: TARGET
Conceptual power path • runtime to measure
One junction / two branches • no validated live navigation
